_doc: DeepResearch-Bench smoke run: 3 tasks (1 ZH Finance + 1 EN Finance + 1 EN Health). Loader: applications/deepresearch_bench/loader.py materializes instance_data from the vendored query.jsonl. Harness: DeepResearchHarness (auto-selected by driver when instance_data['benchmark'] == 'deepresearch_bench'). repo_mapping is SWE-bench specific but RunConfig.compute_run_id requires it for deterministic hashing — placeholders fine, DR harness ignores them. container_image is unused (DR harness reads its own DR_SANDBOX_IMAGE) but required by SweepConfig schema.
